raw: “I’d tell them to head west from my home along Harbor Road. I go to the music store regularly, so that’s the place I’d use. It’s on the right, opposite the fountain. I’d probably mention the fountain first, actually—it’s something to look for rather than just trying to remember which side the shop is on. Fountains make me think about work, too, because I’m a swimming pool caretaker, although that doesn’t help much with the directions. Anyway, west along Harbor Road, then look for the music store on your right, across from the fountain.”
